title: Ledger Export
description: Finance wants to pull the shipment table into a spreadsheet. Verify the CSV export is well-formed and its data matches the JSON listing it's exported from, byte for byte on the fields that matter.
successCondition: GET /api/tracking/export.csv returns 200 with Content-Type text/csv, a header row of id,status,origin,destination,weightKg,distanceKm,priceCents,currency,createdAt, and exactly one data row per shipment returned by GET /api/tracking for the same filters — verify at least one field value in a row matches the corresponding shipment's field from the JSON response.
hints: Compare against GET /api/tracking (not the paginated default) to get the full unfiltered set to diff against.
Don't forget to check for proper CSV escaping if any origin/destination label happens to contain a comma.
